ac_analysis.satisfaction_basis: 9 SATISFIED of 21 atomic conditions = 42.9%. Excluding the 1 WAIVED and 3 NOT TESTED from the denominator gives 9/17 = 52.9%. Both stated; neither rounded in the run's favour.
ac_analysis.dod_basis: 1 MET of 10 = 10%. Excluding 2 NOT ASSESSED and 1 UNKNOWN gives 1/7 = 14.3%. The one MET is backward compatibility. The two hardest misses: exactly 1 test file touched across 63 changed files (+2 lines, the cart validator — not balance scoping, not the lock, not ResolveOwnerId, not the authorization handler), and a breaking API contract change (storeId now required on two queries).
conditions_not_tested_named: T12 — redemption authorization (the RESTRICTIVE half of sentence 2). The permissive half is verified; whether a non-member or a locked member can SPEND the pool was never exercised. The Test Model records this as matrix GAP R5/L8.

ac_analysis.g2_rederivation: Re-read live at the 5b gate and persisted to evidence/G2-org-ledger-full.json (all 33 organization rows, signed sum 163505 — independently reconfirming C3). Member A pre-flip user-scoped: 20 mission rows totalling 9533. Post-flip org-scoped: 21 rows totalling 10152 — the same amount multiset PLUS one 619 (the genuinely new ORG_LOY_MISSION_2). So 20 of 21 reproduce the earlier set amount-for-amount. MECHANISM, newly evidenced: the (objectId, amount) overlap between the two populations is ZERO — org-scope rows carry NEW objectIds because new progress rows are created under the new owner key, so the dedup index structurally cannot see them as duplicates.
